title: Are Large Language Models Consistent over Value-laden Questions?
findings: Fine-tuned chat models, much like human participants, exhibit high inconsistency in their responses to questions about 'Religious Freedom'. This topic was consistently identified as one with the highest levels of inconsistency across various models, in contrast to topics like 'women's rights' where models were much more consistent.
